readings.Aries: You are capable of more gentleness than you usually show. Today would be a good day for it. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Taurus: Your instinct to stay is correct. The reason you're staying is worth examining. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Gemini: The version of events in your head is more interesting than what actually happened. Check the facts. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Cancer: You've been carrying this longer than is reasonable. Set it down. Someone can help you. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Leo: You radiate energy that others orient toward. Use this for good today — including your own good. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Virgo: The health signal you've been ignoring is small now. Address it while it's still small. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Libra: The aesthetic sense that guides your environment also guides your emotional life. What needs rebalancing? Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Scorpio: Your intensity is not too much for the right people. The wrong people will tell you otherwise. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Sagittarius: Not every truth needs to be said. Ask yourself who benefits from this particular one. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Capricorn: Your pragmatism is an asset. There is one area of your life where it is preventing something good. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Aquarius: The network you've built is strong. There is one connection in it that has been neglected and matters. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Pisces: You've given this situation your full emotional presence for a long time. A little more and it shifts. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.

sky_notes: Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
Waning gibbous: the lit fraction shrinks a little each night as the Moon swings back toward the Sun.
Mars and Jupiter are within 4.1° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
